keyword.zh: 电动50和电动60混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动50和电动60混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Both pages print three stone-distance rows. Power, output, pressure and the fine-stone pair are different.
description.zh: 两页都印三行石子距离。功率、产量、压力和细石那一组数字不同。

h1.zh: 电动50和电动60混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 50 and Electric 60 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 50 prints 55 kW, 26 m³/h, 30 MPa and fine-stone 150 m / 350 m. Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and fine-stone 200 m / 600 m. Each page also prints its own 13 mm and 24 mm rows. Do not move the 600 m figure onto the Electric 50 page.
directAnswer.zh: 电动50和电动60是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。电动50印 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa、细石 150 m / 350 m。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、细石 200 m / 600 m。两页还有各自的 13 mm 和 24 mm 行。不要把 600 m 挪到电动50页面上。

heading.en: Where Electric 50 and Electric 60 print different values
heading.zh: 电动50和电动60哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric 50 prints 55 kW; Electric 60 prints 90 kW. Theoretical output: Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h; Electric 60 prints 40 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 50 prints 30 MPa; Electric 60 prints 35 MPa. Hopper capacity: Electric 50 prints 0.4 m³; Electric 60 prints 0.7 m³. Fine-stone conveying (H / V): Electric 50 prints 150 m / 350 m; Electric 60 prints 200 m / 600 m. 13 mm stone (H / V): Electric 50 prints 80 m / 240 m; Electric 60 prints 150 m / 450 m. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动50印 55 kW；电动60印 90 kW。理论输送量：电动50印 26 m³/h；电动60印 40 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动50印 30 MPa；电动60印 35 MPa。料斗容积：电动50印 0.4 m³；电动60印 0.7 m³。细石输送（水平/垂直）：电动50印 150 m / 350 m；电动60印 200 m / 600 m。13 mm石子（水平/垂直）：电动50印 80 m / 240 m；电动60印 150 m / 450 m。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Both pages use the same set of labels. Where the values differ, keep the value on the page you opened. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 两页标题集合相同。数值不同时，以你打开的那一页为准。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Three distance rows on both sheets still leave every number page-specific. Open /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ for Electric 50 and /en/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric 60. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 两边都有三行距离，每个数字仍然只属于自己的页面。看电动50请打开 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/，看电动60请打开 /zh/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 50 print the same motor power as Electric 60?
question.zh: 电动50和电动60的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 prints 55 kW. Electric 60 prints 90 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50印 55 kW。电动60印 90 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 50 print the same theoretical output as Electric 60?
question.zh: 电动50和电动60的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h. Electric 60 prints 40 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50印 26 m³/h。电动60印 40 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 50 print the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 60?
question.zh: 电动50和电动60的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 50 prints 30 MPa. Electric 60 prints 35 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动50印 30 MPa。电动60印 35 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Can I treat Electric 50 and Electric 60 as one concrete pump?
question.zh: 可以把电动50和电动60当成同一台混凝土泵吗？

answer.en: No. They are separate pages from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Match power, output, pressure and distance on the page you intend to order.
answer.zh: 不能。它们是河北品锦机械在邢台的两个页面。要按下单的那一页核对功率、产量、压力和距离。
